schema.description: Schema version. Fixed, so that migrations can apply on load.

id.description: LEGACY, ignored. A Document's identity is its file name (the reader overrides this value and reports a mismatch). Still read in older Projects; never written.

oneOf.description: Shorthand: the title as one plain layer ('{i18n:key}' or literal text).
A string entry is a plain layer.
Title layers, in order; empty means no title. Layers carry pixel offsets and fonts.

size.description: Number of positions. chest: a multiple of 9 (max 54); hopper: 5; dropper: 9. Checked against inventory_type.

inventory_type.description: Container type, chest when absent. chest: 9 × rows; hopper: 5 × 1; dropper: 3 × 3.

vanilla_texture.description: The container's vanilla texture. false: a transparent window, the menu draws its own texture with title glyphs. The resource pack then makes that container texture transparent server-wide, and the server redraws it on other windows of that type.

player_inventory.description: The window's bottom half. visible: the player's real inventory, locked; positions ≥ size are ignored. hidden: only the menu's buttons; positions size..size+35 are the player slots (size..size+26 main inventory, size+27..size+35 hotbar). Either way the content exists only client-side.

permission.description: Permission required to open the menu. Absent: anyone can open it.

inputs.description: Optional named inputs of the menu: its parameters (filled by command arguments or the caller), shared filter/sort/limit, and editor typing. An element can also iterate a source ref directly (iterates.source: "ns:id") without declaring it here.

context_inputs.description: Legacy form of `inputs`: still read, never written.

notes.description: The admin's internal notes, never shown to players. Unlike YAML comments, they survive the editor.

background.description: Default look of the positions no visible element covers.

open_requirements.description: Conditions checked on open. If one fails, the menu does not open.

open_actions.description: Actions run when the menu opens.

close_actions.description: Actions run when the menu closes.

elements.description: The menu's elements, as a flat list. Later elements are drawn on top: when two share a slot, the last one wins.

layers.description: Legacy wrapper around elements: still read, never written. Write `elements`.

metadata.description: Metadata computed by the editor. Not edited by hand.

uses_plugins.description: Third-party plugins the menu references. Computed.

id.description: Layer id, unique in the menu.

notes.description: The admin's internal notes, never shown to players.

elements.description: The layer's elements. When two share a slot, the last one wins.

id.description: Stable element id, unique in the menu.

oneOf.description: A range "10-43" or a comma list "0,8,18-20".
A YAML list of positions and ranges.

positions.description: The slots the element occupies: a number, a range or comma list string, or a YAML list.

iterates.description: Makes the element repeat: once per item of the list `source`, with the current item exposed as {alias} and {alias.field}.

states.description: Guarded states, tried in order before the element's own look. The first whose `if` passes is shown; if none passes, the element's own fields are. A state is a whole look, not a patch.

Element.description: An element: its structural keys (`id`, `positions`, `iterates`, `places`, `states`, `tags`) plus, at the same level, the fields of its look.

ContextInput.description: A named, typed input of the menu. Filled on open by name from the caller (command arguments, the caller's inputs, the current iteration alias) or by an attached data source.

name.description: Name exposed as {name} in the menu's fields. Unique in the menu.

row_of.description: For type "object" or "list": the data source whose row shape this input carries (the caller supplies the value). Editor only; the server ignores it.

default.description: Value used when the caller passes nothing and no data source is attached. Placeholders work.

source.description: When present, a data source supplies the value instead of the caller. Only for type "list" or "object".

ConnectorBinding.description: A data source attached to an input through `source`. The server queries it on render and fills the input with the list or object it returns.

params.description: Parameters for the data source (each source has its own). {name} reads the menu's other inputs.

filter.description: Filters on the data's fields; {name} reads the menu's other inputs. { "category": "{category}" } keeps the items whose category equals the input "category".

limit.description: Maximum number of items. Absent: no limit (the iterating element pages the full list).

Iterates.description: Repeats the element once per item of the list `source`; fields read the current item as {alias.field}.

source.description: A menu input's name, or a source ref (`ns:id` / `pack:id`). An unknown ref gives an empty list.

alias.description: Name of the current item inside the element, exposed as {alias} and {alias.field}.

image.description: One image covering the element's rectangular slot area. Shares its conditions and click actions.

if.description: Conditions, all required. Absent: always matches.

material.description: A vanilla material (DIAMOND), or a placeholder: {input_name} for an input, {alias.field} in a repeating element.

head.description: Custom head when material is PLAYER_HEAD: hdb:<id> (HeadDatabase), basehead:<base64> or playerhead:<name> (placeholders work). Ignored for other materials.

enchants.description: Enchantments, as id → level ({ sharpness: 5 }). Short, namespaced (minecraft:sharpness) and legacy Bukkit ids are read; an unknown id is skipped with a warning. Levels above vanilla's maximum are allowed.

enchanted.description: Enchantment glint without an enchantment. Not needed with `enchants`.

hide.description: Tooltip sections hidden from the player (Bukkit ItemFlag, short spelling).

color.description: Colour #rrggbb for leather armour, potions and firework stars. Ignored on other materials.

nbt.description: Raw SNBT applied last, after every other field (an escape hatch). A parse error is logged and the item renders without it.

notes.description: The admin's internal notes, never shown to players.

item.description: Complete item reference or expression. Quantity and metadata are inherited before explicit presentation overrides.

lore_mode.description: Drops the base item's lore, which is otherwise kept above the explicit lines. Writing {base.lore} in the lore positions that lore instead, and never duplicates it.

Appearance.description: A complete look, shown when its `if` passes. A state replaces the element's own look: what it does not write is absent, never inherited. In a repeating element, fields can read {alias.field}.

State.description: A guarded state: a whole look plus its `if`. The `if` is required (without it the state would always hide the element's own look).

ClickHandler.description: An action chain: a list of steps (or a single step). A plain string is the legacy Action DSL.

steps.description: Legacy wrapper: an Action DSL string inside {steps}.

Step.description: A step: an action without arguments (a bare string), an action (a one-key map), or an if/do/else block.

LText.description: A text: a string ('{i18n:key}' or literal, the same in every language) or a { language: text } map, resolved as the player's language, then the default language, then any entry.

Lore.description: A lore: a list of lines, or, translated, a list of lines per language ({ en: [...], fr: [...] }), each with its own line count.

oneOf.description: A list of lines; a line may be a legacy { language: text } map.
A list of lines per language.

Action.description: An action is a one-key map, the key being the action's name. One argument: the value is the argument; none: null (or a bare string step); several: a map.

oneOf.description: Triggers only: sets the effects the current event declares (join message, death message…). Texts are translated per reader. Ignored with a warning outside a Trigger. `cancel_event` takes no argument and is written as a bare step.

An action declared on the server outside the core: a module's, always prefixed by its namespace (`guilds:rank_delete`), or `module_command` / `cancel_event`. Its arguments come from its declaration, which this schema does not know.

value.description: Read as the Variable's type; a template is resolved first.

Condition.description: An `if` condition: the keyed form (write this one) or the legacy `type:` form (still read).

Places.description: Placement: pins rows of a static source (matched by key) to explicit pages and slots. Not with `iterates`.

source.description: A menu input's name, or a source ref (`ns:id` / `pack:id`).

key_field.description: The row's key in the source.

ConditionKeyed.description: A condition is a one-key map, the key being its name. `or:` and `and:` take a list, `not:` takes one condition.

placeholder.description: A PlaceholderAPI value (%vault_eco_balance%), an input ({category}) or an iteration field ({alias.field}).

Template.description: A template that resolves to the argument's type at run time (ADR triggers-and-variables §6): `{row.price}`, `%vault_eco_balance%`. A value that does not resolve skips the action.

Location.description: A place in a world (ADR triggers-and-variables §4): a template (`{event.location}`, `{var.last_death}`), the text `world x y z [yaw pitch]`, or the fields.
